purpose: neutral C4/W1 data-availability analysis for the protocol v5 owner decision; does not modify the frozen protocol v4

not_recommended.why: still fails T2 W2 (6-7) and lowers the power of the test
ALFRED cannot provide CPILFESL/GS10/TB3MS vintages before 1996-12 and RTDSM has no H.15 rates; a historical tape would be a new source with new licence and audit work
protocol requires W1 and W2; W2 alone would silently drop half the evidence

ordered_options.why: the loss is a source-level data limit (ALFRED has no earlier vintages), not a forecast-quality signal; C4 is a robustness split, so a labelled PSEUDO allowance with a REAL_TIME-only sensitivity keeps the criterion informative for T1

12 origins are unreachable for T2 even with perfect data (W2 has 6 quarters); v5 needs a target-specific minimum (e.g. 4 quarterly origins, or a per-episode rule with reporting) rather than relaxing the global 12
if the owner rejects the PSEUDO allowance, C4 must be stated NOT_APPLICABLE for the blocked pairs; they stay CANDIDATE (no silent pass) and the data gap is reported

rule.c4_text: relative loss <= 1.00 in the origins whose month is an NBER recession month in the chronology as of the evaluation date (a split of the sample made after the fact), in W1 and W2, and the Giacomini-White test with instruments (constant, recession-month indicator of the origin) does not reject; reject means p < 0.10 and the estimated mean loss difference in recession months, the constant plus the indicator coefficient, favours the comparator; with fewer than 12 recession months the result is inconclusive, which counts as not passed and leaves the pair in CANDIDATE
rule.instrument: indicator that the origin month is an NBER recession month, from the chronology as of the evaluation date

mask_definitions.origin_month: the origin month itself is an NBER recession month (C4 text)
mask_definitions.window_overlap: (t, t+h] contains a recession month (mask used by the runner)

structural_findings.finding: Under the mask actually used by the runner ((t,t+h] overlap) C4/W1 fails for T1 only at h=1 (8 origins) and h=3 (10); h=6 (13) and h=12 (19) reach the minimum, but the counts include overlapping forecasts and overstate the independent evidence
Under the C4 text ('the origin month is an NBER recession month') every T1 W1 horizon has 8 REAL_TIME recession origins; the mask definition is a real protocol ambiguity that must be resolved in v5

T2 cannot satisfy C4 under the current rule in any window: W1 has 5-7 and W2 6-7 REAL_TIME recession origins, and W2 has only 18 recession months = 6 quarters, so 12 quarterly origins never exist; the 12-origin minimum is structurally unreachable for T2 even with perfect data
At horizon 0 the runner's (t,t+h] overlap mask is identically zero (the interval is empty); the origin-month reading gives 16 origins in W1 and 18 in W2 (8 and 18 REAL_TIME)

The 1990-91 recession is lost because ALFRED has no vintages before 1996-12 for CPILFESL (1996-12-12), GS10 and TB3MS (1996-12-03), and none before 1991-12-20 for GDPC1; table B-1 lists the blocked pairs
Allowing PSEUDO_REAL_TIME in the C4 split restores T1 W1 to 16 origins at every horizon and T2 W1 to 16/5/5/5; T2 W2 stays at 6-7 and remains below 12

summary.problem: C4 on W1 cannot reach the minimum: the REAL_TIME sample starts 1996-12 while the 1990-91 recession months (1990-08..1991-03) are PSEUDO because ALFRED vintages of CPILFESL and GS10/TB3MS start in 1996-12

V0_v4_current.description: REAL_TIME full-comparator origins, mask = (t, t+h] overlap, minimum 12

V1_mask_origin_month.description: clarify the C4 instrument as 'the origin month is a recession month' (protocol text) instead of the (t,t+h] overlap mask used by the runner

V2_allow_pseudo_for_c4.description: allow PSEUDO_REAL_TIME origins in the C4 recession split only (C4 is a robustness split, not a forecast-quality comparison)

V3_relax_min_recession_origins.description: lower min_recession_months from 12 to 8 / 6 (not recommended: power)

V4_extend_vintage_archives.description: extend REAL_TIME availability to 1990: CPILFESL/GS10/TB3MS (and GDPC1 for T2) with first vintage 1990-03-20
V4_extend_vintage_archives.feasibility: ALFRED has no vintages before 1996-12 for CPILFESL/GS10/TB3MS; the extension needs a different real-time source (BLS CPI archive, a historical H.15 tape). Philadelphia Fed RTDSM does not include H.15 rates (protocol data_manifest). Not achievable from the current channels without new licence documents.

V5_minimal_input_classification.description: classify REAL_TIME by the target's own series only instead of the full comparator input set

V6_not_applicable.description: declare C4 NOT_APPLICABLE for T1/T2 pairs that cannot collect the minimum on REAL_TIME data, instead of INCONCLUSIVE; the pair then does not pass the historical gate (it stays CANDIDATE) but the report does not pretend the criterion was tested

V7_recession_episodes_instead_of_months.description: count distinct recession episodes instead of months (a power-based rule); with REAL_TIME only 1 episode survives in W1 and W2, so any minimum above 1 still fails

V8_c4_on_W2_only.description: restrict the gating C4 to W2 (18 recession origins) and report W1 as a data-limited diagnostic; W2 alone is not enough for the protocol ('W1 and W2' requirement)
